name: Hidden Among Girls
source: “You will play as Yuki, a sweet-faced boy who, for certain reasons, has to attend an all-girls school—without letting anyone find out that he’s actually a boy! ““How long can he hide his true self?”
translation: “你将扮演长相甜美可爱的少年由纪——出于某些特殊原因，他不得不女扮男装入读一所全封闭女校，而且绝对不能让任何人发现他其实是男孩子！”“他究竟能把真实身份隐瞒多久？”
